resources.string: Material presets, fine-tuning and rendering for the glass on the top bar and Explore page
Shares the exact Solid / Glass / Frosted glass presets with the bottom bar; the sliders below fine-tune those preset values
Global strength shared by the Explore rows, top bar and bottom bar; the frosted style reads its own value. Choose the No glass style to turn glass off
Strength %1$d%% · blur %2$s dp · tint %3$s · dispersion %4$s · shell %5$s/%6$s/%7$s · stroke %8$s
100 keeps this style\'s calibrated row value, 0 is weakest, 200 doubles it; applies to both hardware Gaussian and software blur
100 keeps this style\'s calibrated three-colour shell gradient; higher values separate text from the wallpaper more strongly
100 keeps this style\'s calibrated white tint; higher values make the glass surface brighter
100 keeps this style\'s calibrated outline; higher values make the edge clearer
Available on Android 12 and above; disabling forces the verified software blur fallback
When enabled, animated wallpapers are not sampled as a still first frame; disable it to accept a static glass frame
Clears every setting on this page, including the material style and the global glass strength

string-array.name: explore_glass_mode_descriptions
string-array.item: Fully opaque solid colour block in the theme background colour: no wallpaper shows through and no glass layer is drawn; glass strength, e-ink and low-memory settings do not change it

Matches the bottom bar Glass style: 3 + level x 6dp light blur, 0.004 + level x 0.02 near-colourless tint, stronger dispersion and deeper refraction; on the row this means a clearer glass layer and a brighter edge highlight

Matches the bottom bar Frosted glass style: 20 + level x 24dp strong blur, 0.18 + level x 0.20 milky tint, restrained dispersion and shallower refraction; on the row this means a noticeably whiter, softer scrim that barely distorts
